read.thesis: Mid-cycle EBITDA lifted to $2.9B on higher capital costs, with incentive urea at $385/t and 98% ammonia utilisation; tight nitrogen supply through 2027 and no new capacity sanctioned yet.

utilisation.quote: We operated our available ammonia capacity at nearly 98%

capex.peers_comment: Management said the gap between US and rest-of-world construction costs has closed, raising the price needed for new capacity.
capex.quote: construction costs, the gap between the U.S. and the rest of the world has closed.
